Hitsh S/O Rasiklal Shah And Ors vs State Of Maharashtra on 2 January, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/145224296/
1 1. Heard Mr. Meghashyam Kocharekar, learned Counsel appearing for the Applicant and Ms. Ranjana Humane, learned A.P.P. for the Respondent-State.
2. The case of the complainant is that the Applicants herein have taken possession of the flat in question, by commiting a breach of the Order passed by the Civil Court.

Admittedly, there is civil proceeding pending before the Court of the Civil Judge, Junior Division,
Bhiwandi, bearing R.C.S. No.94 of 2016.

entities.text:
Court of the Civil Judge, Junior Division,
Bhiwandi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Ms. Ranjana Humane,
learned A.P.P. for the Respondent-State seeks time to take instructions.
3. In my opinion, the present F.I.R. is nothing, but an attempt to settle a civil dispute by instituting criminal proceedings.
In this premise, interim protection deserves to be granted to the Applicants.
ORDER i.

In event of arrest of the Applicants in connection with offence registered under Sections 420 read with 34 of 6. ABA 3625-2025.doc the Indian Penal Code (IPC) vide F.I.R. No.1302 of 2023 dated 2nd December 2025, the Applicants be released on executing PR bond of Rs.25,000/- each with one or more sureties of the like amount.

ii. The Applicants shall attend the Narpoli Police Station, Bhiwandi, District Thane, on 07/01/2026 and 14/01/2026 from 10:00 a.m. to 2:00 p.m. and thereafter as and when called for by the I.O.
iii.
The Applicants shall not tamper with the evidence/witnesses in any manner.
4. To enable to learned A.P.P. to take instructions, list the matter on 22nd January, 2026 for further consideration.

(SANDESH D. PATIL, J.)
